summary: 100-ft Aermotor lookout erected 1937 at the Pine Island station, Koochiching Co., MN; moved in 2011 and reopened as a climbable tower in Big Bog State Recreation Area.

facts.agency: Minnesota DNR (Big Bog State Recreation Area)

access.note: Visitors may climb the stairs during regular visitor center hours; the sources give no other restriction

visit.trail_note: In the south unit of Big Bog State Recreation Area, on Highway 72, near the visitor center. IFalls guide gives visitor center hours Monday to Saturday, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.

events.note: Erected at the Pine Island station in Koochiching County; built to match an earlier tower on the same site
Moved from Pine Island to the Big Bog State Recreation Area

corrections.why: The Beltrami County report and the DNR both describe the tower as 100 feet, about 30.5 m. The 35 m figure in the record has no matching source in the pages read, and the record takes it from OpenStreetMap.

notes_for_editor: Relocation year 2011 is supported by the county report, the DNR virtual tour and the IFalls guide. Suggest adding year 2011 to the record's relocated event, which has none. One aggregator page (Grokipedia) gives 1995 for the move; it was not used because the county report and DNR both give 2011. The DNR's 1930s-fires sentence refers to towers at Big Bog, not to this one. Waymarking (not read) gives spring 2011 for the move, which would fit. Photos: no verified photo found with a licence; a Minnesota DNR webcam view exists but was not added.
